title: jatropha paviifolia
intro: Jatropha paviifolia, commonly known as the "physic nut" or "purging nut", is a plant species in the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Jatropha paviifolia include its ability to reduce pain and swelling, as well as its capacity to stimulate digestion and relieve nausea. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
